name: ai.sinogate/mcp
title: SinoGate / 深空渡 MCP Server
description: Use SinoGate or 深空渡 chat, image, and video APIs from MCP clients.

environmentVariables.name: SINOGATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Overseas SinoGate API key. Chat, image, and video calls are billed to this account. For 深空渡 you may use SHENKONGDU_API_KEY instead.

environmentVariables.name: SHENKONGDU_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Domestic 深空渡 API key. When set without SINOGATE_API_KEY, defaults to https://api.shenkongdu.com/v1.

environmentVariables.name: SINOGATE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL. Defaults to https://api.sinogate.ai/v1 (or domestic when only SHENKONGDU_API_KEY is set).
